answer: Start from something the operator cannot copy for free: a bond keyed to a hardware root, locked before the identity may post. Split the bond across independent auditors so no single raven can release it. Replay every submission against the previous epoch; duplicates surface there, not in the display name. Then a farm on the same oasis sees its bond frozen on the ridge of a failed audit, and the moderator can point at the number instead of the story.
